parameters.query: SELECT bgc.use_ask($1) AS questions, bgc.ask_limit() AS lim

SELECT CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN bgc.shelf_view($1, 'mine', NULL) END AS own, bgc.friend_by_name($1, $3) AS fid, CASE WHEN bgc.friend_by_name($1, $3) IS NOT NULL THEN bgc.shelf_view($1, 'friend:' || bgc.friend_by_name($1, $3), NULL) END AS visit

SELECT bgc.lookup_games($1, $2::jsonb) AS games, CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN bgc.buy_pool($1) END AS pool, bgc.curator_card() AS curator, CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN bgc.friends_pool($1) END AS fpool, bgc.asker_extras($1) AS extras, CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN bgc.rulebooks_for($2::jsonb) END AS rules
